# CEVA Logistics opens Derby distribution centre for UK eCommerce 

 

> CEVA Logistics opens Derby distribution centre for UK eCommerce 

CEVA Logistics has opened a new 508,000-square-foot distribution centre in Derby, expanding its UK contract logistics network to support growing demand from the eCommerce sector.

The facility is scheduled to become fully operational in August 2026. It will provide storage, handling and distribution services for global eCommerce customers, helping speed up deliveries across the UK.

The new operation is expected to create around 300 jobs, strengthening the regional logistics sector while supporting CEVA’s continued investment in the UK market.

The warehouse was designed with sustainability and scalability in mind. It has achieved BREEAM Excellent and EPC A+ certifications and features a rooftop solar installation to reduce energy consumption.

# New distribution center coming to Jackson Co. will employ nearly 150

Posted by kenstanford on September 9, 2026 in Local News, Local Business 

A new distribution center is coming to Jackson County, bringing with it 140 new jobs.

Parts Town Unlimited, a distributor of OEM (original equipment manufacturer) parts for commercial foodservice, residential appliances, and HVAC equipment, has leased a 538,000-squar-foot facility in the 85 North Business Park (Jackson 85 North) in Pendergrass and plans to move in by the end of the year.

The new facility will expand the company’s global fulfillment network to the Southeast, joining existing centers in Chicago, Phoenix and Munich. 

“Our new Global Fulfillment Center represents an important next step in the evolution of our North American distribution network and positions us to serve our customers and manufacturer partners with even greater speed, flexibility and scale,” said CEO Bill Geary.

results.author: Gowtham Ramachandran
results.text:
Maersk Opens $100M Boston Fulfillment Hub for Unnamed Retailer 

# Maersk is opening a $100M fulfillment hub near Boston

Gowtham Ramachandran

Jul 20, 2026

The news: Maersk will open a $100 million fulfillment hub in Hopedale, Massachusetts, in late August. The site will run fulfillment for a single large e-commerce company that Maersk has not named.

It is the shipping line’s largest New England facility. Broker Cushman & Wakefield called it the largest new industrial lease in Greater Boston since 2020.

By the numbers:

- 617,000 square feet and about 1,000 jobs
- Up to 330,000 units a day at peak
- Conveyor and sortation equipment throughout

The strategy: Maersk is expanding its landside logistics because its shipping business is a rollercoaster. Ocean revenue ran from $29 billion in 2020 up to $64 billion in 2022, then back down to $35 billion last year as freight rates collapsed. Logistics revenue, by contrast, grew steadily to about $15 billion over the same period.

To build its logistics business, Maersk has spent roughly $10 billion buying warehouse and delivery companies, including LF Logistics for $3.6 billion in 2022. Its directory now lists more than 100 warehouses

# Online Brands Nordic AB (publ) tecknar hyresavtal i Falkenberg

MFN

18 augusti, 13:02

Online Brands Nordic AB (publ) har tecknat ett tioårigt hyresavtal med Laustea AB avseende en ny logistikanläggning om 24 695 kvadratmeter i Falkenberg. Anläggningen uppförs av Laustea AB och beräknas stå klar för inflyttning hösten 2027.

Den nya anläggningen kommer att samla Online Brands Nordics lager- och logistikverksamhet under ett och samma tak. Falkenberg har ett strategiskt läge för logistik, med direkt anslutning till E6 och närhet till flera hamnar. Anläggningen miljöcertifieras enligt Miljöbyggnad Silver och förses med solceller på taket.

– Den nya anläggningen är ett viktigt steg i Online Brands Nordics fortsatta utveckling. Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

# Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

 Wagner Logistics 

Oct 14, 2026, 08:54 ET

NORTH KANSAS CITY, Mo., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wagner Logistics, a nationwide provider of third-party logistics, today announced it has signed a multi-year agreement with a Kansas City-area manufacturer to launch a new manufacturing support and warehouse operations program in Liberty, Mo.

The new operation includes two leased warehouse facilities in the Liberty area totaling more than 830,000 square feet. Wagner expects to add 79 new local jobs over the next two years, starting immediately. The company will also make a multi-million-dollar investment in equipment, infrastructure and automated trailer loading and unloading technology to support the operation.

"This is exactly the kind of operation where Wagner's strengths come through," said Brian Smith, President and Chief Executive Officer of Wagner Logistics. "It requires speed, flexibility, close coordination and the ability to design a solution around what the customer actually needs."

Al Sharqi Shipping Opens AED 70M Logistics Hub in Dubai Industrial City

## Al Sharqi Shipping inaugurates AED 70 million multi-temperature integrated logistics and distribution hub at Dubai Industrial City

October 15, 2026

- Spanning 280,000 sq. ft. of built-up storage area and 200,000 sq. ft. of open yard space, the new facility will cater to domestic demand and strengthen the regional supply chains
- Investment expected to create 500 new jobs and will support F&B, FMCG, retail, manufacturing, and quick-commerce sectors, among others

Al Sharqi Shipping, a leading UAE-based logistics service provider, has inaugurated its new integrated logistics and distribution hub at Dubai Industrial City, part of TECOM Group PJSC.

The newly launched facility represents an investment of AED 70 million and will serve customers across food and beverage, Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), retail, hotels, restaurants, and cafés (HoReCa), quick-commerce, and manufacturing industries. It will cater to domestic demand while enhancing Al Sharqi Shipping’s regional distribution capabilities.

# Hellmann Worldwide Logistics Polska joins MLP Poznań. MLP Group strengthens its position as the partner of choice for logistics leaders

 

 Hellmann Worldwide Logistics Polska will become a new tenant at MLP Poznań, leasing 5,350 sqm of modern warehouse and office space. The company will commence operations at the dedicated facility in the first quarter of next year. The transaction further strengthens MLP Group’s position as a partner of choice for fast-growing logistics operators seeking modern space in strategic locations. 

Hellmann Worldwide Logistics Polska has leased a total of 5,350 sqm at the MLP Poznań logistics park. Nearly 500 sqm will be allocated to office and staff facilities, with the remaining space used for modern warehousing operations. The facility is scheduled for completion in the first quarter of next year. Hellmann Worldwide Logistics Polska was advised by BNP Paribas Real Estate Poland throughout the transaction.
